name: Fuobe scale surreal

dataset.what: Composites Fuobe made from its own photos: giant props, tiny worlds.
captions: Every caption starts with "fbgiantscale, " and names what is giant and what is tiny in the same words each time, then the scene in one long sentence.
No names of people, brands or photographers.

notes: fal trains on Z-Image base: whether a base-trained LoRA behaves the same on Z-Image Turbo (Soul's model) is unverified; AI-Toolkit trains on Turbo with the training adapter, so the first evaluation compares the two routes' files on Soul.
